summary: Close browser collection sockets synchronously on pagehide and resubscribe retained back/forward-cache pages

schema.detail: No durable schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No daemon or fleet rules change.

compatibility.detail: Pagehide sends WebSocket close code 1001 before asynchronous scope disposal. Persisted pagehide retains its scope, and persisted pageshow reconnects and resubscribes existing interests without lifecycle timers.

downtime.detail: Page-local sockets are closed during navigation; retained pages reconnect on restoration.

manual.detail: No manual action required. Socket probe and creation spans retain trace propagation on reconnect.

recovery.detail: Reloading the previous frontend restores its page lifecycle behavior; no persistent state requires recovery.
